subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: What Google Chat auth and event-ingestion model should OpenClaw support for non-mention Space messages?
rationale: The request is valid, but a fix would expand message visibility and add user OAuth or subscription credentials, so automation should not choose the security and product shape alone.

options.title: Design plugin-local OAuth/events
options.body: Define a Google Chat plugin design for user OAuth or Workspace event ingestion, including scopes, SecretRef storage, consent, fallback behavior, docs, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Thread first, auth later
options.body: Land or replace the narrower thread/session work first and keep all-message Space ingestion tracked as a separate auth/security design item.

options.title: Keep service-account-only
options.body: Defer non-mention Space ingestion and document that Google Chat HTTP endpoint deployments require mentions until maintainers are ready to own broader message access.

recommendation.title: Design plugin-local OAuth/events
recommendation.body: Define a Google Chat plugin design for user OAuth or Workspace event ingestion, including scopes, SecretRef storage, consent, fallback behavior, docs, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent Google Chat history and prior review context around the exact auth/thread surfaces.
